title: Skill Validation Run + Diff Evaluation
description: Spawn a sandboxed agent-manager run executing a skill against a golden; await completion; read the sandbox diff; evaluate it against the manifest; produce a verdict.

requirements.title: agent-manager run orchestration
requirements.description: Connect-RPC client to agent-manager: spawn run with skill content + golden path + sandbox mode; poll for completion; fetch run summary (duration, tokens_used, cost_estimate, started_at, ended_at) and sandbox diff. Handle run-failure cases (timeout, error, crash) explicitly.

validation.notes: Worker spawns the run, awaits terminal, fetches summary + diff, persists a record.
Adapter fetches the run diff and stores a sha256 content hash + changed paths.

Live loop proven 2026-05-29: golden seeded, skill content delivered, agent ran sandboxed; run_failure (no manifest), pass (manifest pinned), and stale (skill_drift) all observed with persisted records.

requirements.title: Diff-vs-manifest evaluator
requirements.description: Pure-function evaluator: given a diff (file path list + content patches) and a manifest, return verdict ∈ {pass, unexpected-mutation, run-failure} plus a per-file breakdown of allowed vs unexpected paths. No side effects; testable in isolation.

validation.notes: Pure evaluator composes manifest classification with run/tool failure short-circuits.
Disallowed diff path yields the unexpected-mutation verdict end-to-end through the worker.
